card.name: Words before more-common or usually-reversible
card.fires_on: Small words such as is, are, slightly or more right after a medical condition or effect as subject, where a comparison or degree word like more common, more likely or usually reversible comes next.

modes.label: Before 'more common'
modes.description: Degree or linking word after a disease that leads into a comparison of who gets it.
modes.example: They are<< slightly>> more common in men.

modes.label: Before 'usually reversible'

modes.label: Before 'more likely'
modes.description: Verb after a condition that leads into a risk comparison.
modes.example: Hyperkalemia<< is>> more likely to occur in patients with renal

card.plain: It fires on the word just before the text says a condition is more common or more likely in some group, or is usually reversible.
